contract.label: Input
contract.summary: A single-line text field with focus, disabled, and invalid states.
contract.purpose: The single-line text field. It renders the destructive border and ring from `aria-invalid`, so the invalid state is a data attribute rather than a class override.
useWhen: A single line of free text or a number is entered.
It sits inside a `field`, which supplies the label, description and error slots.
dontUseWhen: The value belongs to a known set — that is `select`, `combobox`, or `radio-group`.
The control needs an affix, icon, or button inside it — that is `input-group`.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height — default (2rem) or sm (1.75rem). Match the other controls in the same toolbar.

props.name: surface
props.description: What the field sits on — default inside a card, sheet, dialog or table row, where it rests clear so the surface shows through; page straight on the shell's muted content area, where it takes the outline Button's face so a filter row reads as one surface.

requires: A programmatic label: `field`'s `FieldLabel`, or an `aria-label` where no visible label exists.
`aria-invalid` on the control when validation fails, paired with a `FieldError` that names what is wrong.
forbids: Re-styling the invalid state with border or ring utilities — the primitive renders it from `aria-invalid`.
A fixed px width. The field fills its container and the layout decides the measure.
Re-tinting the resting surface with a `bg-*` class so the field reads on the page body — set `surface="page"`, which is the outline Button's face in both themes.
rules: **Pick the surface by what is underneath.** A field placed straight on the shell's `muted` content area — a search box, a filter row — takes `surface="page"`, the outline Button's resting face (`outline-surface`), so the row reads as one surface. Inside a `card`, `sheet`, `dialog` or table row it keeps `default`.

behavior.error: Invalid means `aria-invalid` on the control plus an inline `FieldError` naming the problem — never a generic toast, and never a silently blocked submit button.

requirements: Colour is never the only error signal; the message carries the meaning.

examples: `<Input size="sm" surface="page" placeholder="Search meters" />` beside `<Button variant="outline" size="sm">` in a filter row on the page body.
antiPatterns: A required field that blocks submission with no inline message.
Hand-drawn focus styling that replaces the `ring` token.

A field on the muted page body given `bg-background`, `bg-card` or `bg-white` instead of `surface="page"` — in dark mode `background` is darker than `card`, so the field sinks below the cards beside it.
